description: This script is a command-line utility for fixing translation issues in markdown documentation files within a FastAPI project. It processes files by comparing translated documents to their English counterparts and auto-fixes discrepancies.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: CLI application object from the Typer library used to define command-line commands and options.

methods.name: iter_all_lang_paths
methods.description: Iterates over markdown files in language-specific directories, prioritizing certain subdirectories.

methods.name: get_all_paths
methods.description: Retrieves relative paths of documentation files to be processed, excluding non-translated sections.

methods.name: process_one_page
methods.description: Fixes a single translated markdown document by comparing it to the English version and applying corrections.
